row.evidence: Todoist's Business plan adds team roles, activity logs and team domain discovery, but its pricing page and help centre describe no SAML SSO or SCIM; people are invited by email or join via Team Discovery and are removed manually.
row.notes: No SCIM or SAML SSO on any plan: pricing page lists Beginner (free), Pro ($5/user/mo, $60/yr) and Business ($8/user/mo, $96/yr); the help-centre sitemap (all locales) has no SSO, SAML, SCIM or provisioning articles; the Okta OIN app is SWA only. Pro is an individual plan, so the team plan is Business. Workspace membership can be scripted through the public Todoist API v1 (list workspace users, invite by email, change role, remove user) with a personal or OAuth bearer token; no plan gate is stated for the API.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Team workspace with roles and granular team activity logs.

scim.notes: No SCIM documented. Team security options cover team domains, Team Discovery and guest restrictions only.

capabilities.notes: Removing a workspace user removes them from the team (not an account delete); each Todoist account is personal.

endpoints.purpose: Invite users to a workspace by email
Remove a user from a workspace

audit_log_api.notes: GET /api/v1/activities returns the authenticated user's activity events (projects, tasks, comments, sections); not documented as an admin audit-log API.

rate_limits.text: Sync API: up to 1000 partial and 100 full sync requests per user per 15 minutes; up to 100 commands per request.

limitations.text: Admins or members cannot be downgraded to guests via role change.

okta.notes: OIN page ticks SWA only (last updated 2014).

fallbacks.other_sync: Team Discovery: anyone with the linked corporate email domain can find and join the team (billed as a member on Business).
